description: Source code defining the Categorical distribution class in PyTorch, including its methods and properties.

classes.name: Categorical
classes.description: A class representing the categorical distribution parameterized by probabilities or logits.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Categorical distribution with probabilities or logits.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Returns an expanded version of the distribution with a new batch shape.

methods.name: _new
methods.description: Creates a new tensor with the same type as the distribution's parameters.

methods.name: support
methods.description: Returns the support constraints for the distribution (integer interval).

methods.name: logits
methods.description: Lazy property converting probs to logits.

methods.name: probs
methods.description: Lazy property converting logits to probs.

methods.name: param_shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the distribution parameters.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution (not implemented, returns NaN).

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the distribution.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution (not implemented, returns NaN).

methods.name: log_prob
methods.description: Calculates the log probability of given values.

methods.name: entropy
methods.description: Calculates the entropy of the distribution.

methods.name: enumerate_support
methods.description: Returns all possible values in the support.
